about: Recorded /queue/api/status payloads (admin view, level minimal), every distinct 200 body in arrival order, from a scratch library with two processors whose runner is tests/fixtures/fake_runner.py: two synthetic series x three volumes on two OCR rows (a row switch is a new session: Loading), then two more volumes once both machines had been idle. `t` is seconds since the first poll; `t0_wall` is the wall clock at t=0, so a replay can re-base every instant in a payload on when it serves it.
